cues.zh: Paul Henningkamp，

cues.zh: 或者大家更熟悉他的另一个名字，

cues.en: PHK,
cues.zh: PHK，

cues.en: on annual status report
cues.zh: 带来关于

cues.zh: NSA Operation Orchestra 的年度进展报告。

cues.en: Welcome. Thank you.
cues.zh: 欢迎。谢谢。

cues.en: So a couple of years ago there was a news item that made me sit up in the chair and think.
cues.zh: 几年前有一则新闻，让我猛地坐直身子陷入深思。

cues.en: It's probably not the one you think about now.
cues.zh: 可能并不是你们现在想到的那条。

cues.en: The director of CIA
cues.zh: CIA 局长的

cues.en: had his love affair exposed by the FBI
cues.zh: 婚外情被 FBI 曝光了，

cues.en: because they traced his telecommunication.
cues.zh: 就因为他们追踪了他的通信记录。

cues.en: Being a security researcher, which is not normally something I call myself,
cues.zh: 作为一名安全研究人员（虽然我平时不太这么自称），

cues.en: is a matter of imagination.
cues.zh: 靠的就是想象力。

cues.en: In a situation like that you need to sit back and try to think like the minds who did that.
cues.zh: 遇到这种情况，你得靠在椅子上，试着像干这事的人那样去思考。

cues.en: Later on we got Edward Snowden's disclosures,
cues.zh: 后来，Edward Snowden 曝光了那些内幕，

cues.en: and I sat down
cues.zh: 我坐下来

cues.en: and I thought, what would I do if I have a budget of $1,000,000,000
cues.zh: 心想：如果我坐拥 10 亿美元的预算，

cues.en: and a mandate, an order to collect as much communication
cues.zh: 并且接到指令，要求收集尽可能多的

cues.en: as possible?
cues.zh: 通信数据，我会怎么做？

cues.en: Then a week ago I got an email from Philip
cues.zh: 接着在一周前，我收到了 Philip 的一封邮件，

cues.en: going like, I need a keynote speaker, what are you doing next weekend?
cues.zh: 大意是：“我缺个主题演讲嘉宾，你下周末有空吗？”

cues.en: And since I owe Philip a lot of favors I said I can do that.
cues.zh: 既然我欠了 Philip 不少人情，我就说“没问题”。

cues.en: And
cues.zh: 然后，

cues.en: then I sat down and made a set of slides.
cues.zh: 我就坐下来做了一套幻灯片。

cues.en: The basic premise here is that you should imagine
cues.zh: 这里的基本设定是，请大家想象一下：

cues.en: a junior NSA staffer arriving in Brussels to give a
cues.zh: 一名初入职的 NSA 员工来到布鲁塞尔，本打算就

cues.en: update to NATO on one of the NSA programmes and then because he's American he ends up here instead.
cues.zh: 某个 NSA 项目向北约做汇报，结果因为是美国人搞不清路况，误打误撞跑到了这里。

cues.en: If I had a lot of time I would have done the part, you know, the black hair, the sunglasses and all that, but you'll just have to imagine that.
cues.zh: 要是时间充裕，我肯定会演得更像一点，比如染个黑发、戴上墨镜什么的，但现在大家就只能靠脑补了。

cues.en: So
cues.zh: 那么

cues.en: this is Operation Orchestra and this is of course top secret
cues.zh: 这就是 Operation Orchestra，当然，这是绝密，

cues.en: and none of this will exit this room I'm sure.
cues.zh: 我相信这些内容绝不会传出这个房间。

cues.en: So the orchestra operation
cues.zh: 那么，Operation Orchestra

cues.en: has as a primary objective to reduce the cost of gathering information.
cues.zh: 其首要目标就是降低获取信息的成本。

cues.en: NSA has
cues.zh: NSA 在

cues.en: in the law that controls their funding it says collect as much information as possible And as a responsible government agency we're trying to do it as cost effectively as possible.
cues.zh: 掌管其经费的法律中明确写着：尽可能多地收集信息。而作为一个负责任的政府机构，我们正努力以尽可能高的性价比来完成。

cues.en: So
cues.zh: 所以

cues.en: Operation Orchestra is about reducing NSA
cues.zh: Operation Orchestra 就是为了降低 NSA

cues.en: cost of collecting information.
cues.zh: 收集信息的成本。

cues.en: And all of it has to be above board. There's no black ops allowed.
cues.zh: 而且这一切都必须光明正大，绝不允许有黑色行动。

cues.en: Black ops are where you break the laws.
cues.zh: 所谓的黑色行动就是违法乱纪。

cues.en: And we have no special authorisations.
cues.zh: 我们没有任何特殊授权。

cues.en: We have no seven with a licence to wiretap or anything of the sort.
cues.zh: 我们可没有持有“窃听执照”的 007 之类的人物。

cues.en: And the means, the way we do this is we try to eliminate,
cues.zh: 至于手段，我们的做法就是试图消灭、

cues.en: prevent or weaken encryption.
cues.zh: 阻止或削弱加密。

cues.en: We try to enable access to information, and we try to frustrate players that are trying to make it harder for us.
cues.zh: 我们努力实现对信息的获取，并挫败那些试图给我们制造阻碍的对手。

cues.en: And the history about, this is actually a very old programme.
cues.zh: 至于历史——这其实是一个非常悠久的项目。

cues.en: It started out very soon after the escape of the internet.
cues.zh: 它在互联网“出逃”后不久就启动了。

cues.en: The internet was meant for the military, it was not meant for grandmother
cues.zh: 互联网本是给军方使用的，可不是为了老奶奶

cues.en: and terrorists and so on. And the big problem with Internet is unlike the telecommunication
cues.zh: 以及恐怖分子等人准备的。而互联网最大的问题在于，它不像我们过去熟知的

cues.en: network as we knew it, you can plug anything into the Internet. You don't have to get approval first.
cues.zh: 电信网络那样——在互联网上你可以接入任何设备，不需要事先经过审批。

cues.en: People can build their own computers and hook them up to the network. You couldn't do that with the old telecommunications network. You went to the FCC and you got a little sticker and all this stuff. So suddenly we are in this unregulated network
cues.zh: 人们可以自己造电脑并连上网络。以前的电信网络可不能这么干，你得去找 FCC，拿到认证贴纸等等。所以突然之间，我们就面对着这样一个不受监管的网络，

cues.en: and there's far too many players in the network. It used to be we will just talk to AT and T and we could wire tap anybody.
cues.zh: 而且网络中的参与者实在太多了。换作以前，我们只要找 AT&T 谈谈，就能窃听任何人。

cues.en: And they would happily do that. Now we have you know
cues.zh: 他们会很乐意这么做。现在，你知道，

cues.en: millions of internet networks
cues.zh: 数百万个互联网网络

cues.en: and many
cues.zh: 而且很多

cues.en: of them abroad and we cannot negotiate with all of them. We have to find scalable methods to deal with this.
cues.zh: 都在国外，我们不可能和所有网络逐一谈判。我们必须找到可扩展的方法来处理这个问题。

cues.en: And
cues.zh: 而且

cues.en: our attempt to try to manipulate the OSI protocols in instead of the TCPIP protocols unfortunately failed.
cues.zh: 我们试图操纵 OSI 协议，而不是 TCP/IP 协议，但很遗憾失败了。

cues.en: That would have
cues.zh: 那本来会

cues.en: continued the
cues.zh: 延续电话网络的

cues.en: connection oriented models of the telephone network, but that didn't work. That was really too bad.
cues.zh: 面向连接模型，但最终没有成功。那确实很遗憾。

cues.en: The origin of it is the Deep Thought Working Group,
cues.zh: 它的起源是 Deep Thought 工作组，

cues.en: which came up with these ideas of trying to gain control of the key leverage points on the internet. There are still some places
cues.zh: 这个小组提出了设法控制互联网关键杠杆点的想法。现在仍然有一些地方

cues.en: where things really happen. Inference the process to our advantage and to identify
cues.zh: 是真正产生作用的。我们要把推断过程为我方所用，并找出

cues.en: leveraged persons where low cost can get a high impact.
cues.zh: 那些低成本就能带来高影响的关键人物。

cues.en: So
cues.zh: 所以

cues.en: one of the new things in operation,
cues.zh: 新出现的一项运作方式，

cues.en: in the orchestra operation is what we call abber operations.
cues.zh: 在整个运作体系中，我们称之为 abber 运作。

cues.en: And
cues.zh: 而且

cues.en: this is a very old problem. Some smart inventor will invent something that makes our life more difficult.
cues.zh: 这是一个非常老的问题。有些聪明的发明者会发明出让我们生活更困难的东西。

cues.en: And
cues.zh: 而且

cues.en: we don't want that. So what do we do? So the way we used to do this is we would try to bribe him. Try to hire him or something. We would classify his patent.
cues.zh: 我们不想这样。那该怎么办？过去我们的做法是试着贿赂他。或者想办法雇用他。我们会把他的专利列为机密。

cues.en: So he would get a patent, but he wouldn't show it to anybody.
cues.zh: 这样他就能获得专利，但不会向任何人公开。

cues.en: Some cases we can swear people to silence, you know, national security, yada yada, the president will give you a handshake and all this stuff. But there's a lot of paperwork involved in this, and it leaves a lot of traces.
cues.zh: 有些情况下，我们可以让人发誓保密，你知道，国家安全之类的，总统会和你握手，诸如此类。但这会涉及大量文书工作，也会留下很多痕迹。

cues.en: And involves many people. So it's kind of an expensive process. So
cues.zh: 而且牵涉很多人。所以这算是个昂贵的过程。所以

cues.en: we found a new way to do this. We're using the raw capitalism of the market. We're simply throwing money at the problem.
cues.zh: 我们找到了新做法。我们利用市场最原始的资本主义。就是直接拿钱砸这个问题。

cues.en: So
cues.zh: 所以

cues.en: we've got some startup that's going to give us problems. We read Hacker News and all that stuff of course. So
cues.zh: 我们找到一家会给我们制造问题的初创公司。当然，我们会看 Hacker News 之类的东西。所以

cues.en: there's this venture capitalist who contacts them. It's like, oh I saw you on Hagar News. Can I drop by?
cues.zh: 有个风险投资人联系他们。他说，哦，我在 Hacker News 上看到你。我能来拜访吗？

cues.en: So this dude drops by and you know chats them up and
cues.zh: 于是这家伙上门了，你懂的，跟他们闲聊，然后

cues.en: invites them out for a fancy dinner and you know drops 10 ks dollars. Get some better chairs or something you know. Keep me posted right?
cues.zh: 请他们出去吃顿高档晚餐，你懂的，扔下 1 万美元。买几把好点的椅子什么的，你懂的。有进展告诉我，对吧？

cues.en: And then now that he knows what they're up to
cues.zh: 然后现在他知道他们在搞什么了

cues.en: he comes home and we start looking for a good patent.
cues.zh: 他回来，我们就开始找一项好专利。

cues.en: If we're lucky this patent is already with one of the friends of NSA,
cues.zh: 如果走运，这项专利已经在 NSA 的某个朋友手里，

cues.en: and we drop a line to IBM and for their patent lawyers and say you should look at these guys because that's awfully close to your patent.
cues.zh: 然后我们给 IBM 和他们的专利律师递个话，说你们该看看这些家伙，因为这跟你们的专利太接近了。

cues.en: Likely as not, IBM will send out a couple of patent lawyers with a clutch of patents and that startup will be dead.
cues.zh: 十有八九，IBM 会派出几个专利律师，带着一堆专利，那家初创公司就完蛋了。

cues.en: And very often they'll even call the venture capitalists back and say, oh we're sorry.
cues.zh: 而且他们常常还会给风险投资人回电话说，哦，很抱歉。

cues.en: So we get feedback. We know they're stopped. It's wonderful and it's
cues.zh: 所以我们能得到反馈。我们知道他们被拦住了。这很棒，而且只要

cues.en: 30 ks dollars.
cues.zh: 3 万美元。

cues.en: If the patent
cues.zh: 如果这项专利

cues.en: is not in what we call good hands we'll obviously try to find a better patent or we'll try to get it transferred. There are some very
cues.zh: 不在我们所说的可靠的人手里，我们显然会试着找一项更好的专利，或者试着把它转让过来。有一些非常

cues.en: cooperative
cues.zh: 配合的

cues.en: patent companies out there who will go out and buy a patent
cues.zh: 专利公司，他们会出去买一项专利

cues.en: so that they can use it on our behalf.
cues.zh: 好让他们能代表我们使用它。

cues.en: It's
cues.zh: 这

cues.en: a very convenient process.
cues.zh: 是一个非常方便的过程。

cues.en: We've used some of the same to solve another problem. We have this problem with people who are
cues.zh: 我们也用类似的方法解决了另一个问题。比如有些人

cues.en: working for us in different situations
cues.zh: 在各种境况下为我们工作，

cues.en: and we need to reward them. And this used to be sort of of bogus aberration, you know, they would suddenly win the lottery.
cues.zh: 我们需要给他们报酬。过去这往往得编些离奇的借口，比如他们突然中了彩票，

cues.en: Some distant relative would have left them a fortune.
cues.zh: 或者某个远房亲戚给他们留了一大笔遗产。

cues.en: We're kind of sorry about the Nigerian scam, but that's kind of how it started.
cues.zh: 尼日利亚骗局那事儿我们挺过意不去的，不过它大概就是这么来的。

cues.en: People get amazing job offers.
cues.zh: 有人拿到了待遇惊人的工作 offer，

cues.en: Sometimes new identities,
cues.zh: 有时甚至是换个新身份，

cues.en: sort of stuff like that, and you have to bend a lot of rules to do that.
cues.zh: 诸如此类，而且为了做到这些你不得不破很多规矩。

cues.en: And it's hard to hide the trails and Google has made this incredibly difficult. It's like oh so you suddenly have this distant relative who left. Why can't we find any traces of this person on Google at all? It's like...
cues.zh: 要抹掉痕迹很难，Google 更是让这变得无比棘手。就比如：“哦，你突然冒出个留下遗产的远亲？那为什么我们在 Google 上完全搜不到这人的任何痕迹呢？”就像……

cues.en: Right.
cues.zh: 对吧。

cues.en: Now it's much easier today.
cues.zh: 而如今这事容易多了。

cues.en: Hi. I quit. Then he makes a startup finds a venture capitalist who dumps a couple of millions on him. And then he sits browsing the Internet for a couple of years or whatever he wants to do.
cues.zh: “嗨，我不干了。”接着他去创个业，找个风投给他砸个几百万。然后他就能坐着刷两三年网页，想干嘛干嘛。

cues.en: And that's it.
cues.zh: 这就搞定了。

cues.en: Paperwork is standard. There's a tax form for this.
cues.zh: 手续完全合规，连税表都有现成的。

cues.en: Right?
cues.zh: 对吧？

cues.en: And that's actually, one of these dudes actually ended up making a company that worked. That's like
cues.zh: 实际上，其中一个哥们儿最后真把公司给做成了。那可真是

cues.en: really big. So this is a way to
cues.zh: 做大了。所以这成了一种

cues.en: move money into our objectives. This is a way we can move money into people that we want to do things.
cues.zh: 把资金注入我们目标的方式。我们可以借此把钱给到那些我们想让他们去办事的人手里。

cues.en: So,
cues.zh: 那么，

cues.en: in the other end of the scale, speaking of money, we have what we call the overdrive
cues.zh: 在天平的另一端，说到钱，我们还有所谓的“超速”

cues.en: activities.
cues.zh: 行动。

cues.en: This is about influencing
cues.zh: 这是关于影响

cues.en: business decisions.
cues.zh: 商业决策的。

cues.en: We use NSA's
cues.zh: 我们利用 NSA 的

cues.en: contracting. We have rather big purchasers of IT services.
cues.zh: 合同采购。我们是 IT 服务的大买家。

cues.en: And we can pretty much decide who we give the order to ourselves. There's no fair purchasing when it's national security.
cues.zh: 订单给谁，基本上我们自己说了算。涉及国家安全，就没什么公平采购可言。

cues.en: And the good thing about contract law is you can do anything.
cues.zh: 合同法的好处是，你几乎什么都能做。

cues.en: It cannot be directly illegal. You cannot have a contract to kill somebody, but you can do anything
cues.zh: 不能直接违法。你不能签一份杀人的合同，但只要法律允许的事，

cues.en: that's possible within the law with a contract.
cues.zh: 都可以用合同来做。

cues.en: And it's a very good mechanism to solve big problems. The bad news is that usually very big players, so there's lawyers and it's kind of expensive and stuff like that.
cues.zh: 这是解决大问题的一个非常好的机制。坏消息是，通常都是体量很大的对手，所以要请律师，成本也挺高，诸如此类。

cues.en: And there can be some objective screw, but it's a good way to solve problems. And this is actually how we solve the Skype problem.
cues.zh: 而且可能会有一些客观上的偏差，但这确实是解决问题的一个好办法。我们解决 Skype 问题实际上就是这么干的。

cues.en: Skype was peer to peer encrypted video and audio.
cues.zh: Skype 是点对点加密的视频和音频通话。

cues.en: They didn't use standard protocols.
cues.zh: 他们没有使用标准协议。

cues.en: They are out of the FTC. We cannot just say this is illegal and get them banned.
cues.zh: 他们游离于 FTC 的管辖之外。我们不能直接说它违法然后查禁它。

cues.en: It's not open source,
cues.zh: 它也不是开源的，

cues.en: And they did not bite on our attempt to write them.
cues.zh: 而且我们试图收买他们时，他们也没有上钩。

cues.en: It's very popular with independent actors,
cues.zh: 它在独立人士中非常流行，

cues.en: human rights groups in Belarusia
cues.zh: 比如白俄罗斯的人权组织

cues.en: for instance.
cues.zh: 就在用。

cues.en: It's also very popular with political movements adverse to The US cause in Middle East,
cues.zh: 它在中东那些与美国利益相悖的政治运动中也很受欢迎，

cues.en: and of course terrorist usage, we're absolutely sure.
cues.zh: 当然，我们非常确定恐怖分子也在用它。

cues.en: So first we partnered with eBay, which is a very special friend of NSA,
cues.zh: 于是我们首先与 eBay 合作，它是 NSA 非常特殊的朋友，

cues.en: And
cues.zh: 而

cues.en: for some minor considerations in foreign intelligence,
cues.zh: 出于情报方面的一些小考虑，

cues.en: they bought Skype for us.
cues.zh: 他们替我们买下了 Skype。

cues.en: Unfortunately,
cues.zh: 不幸的是，

cues.en: they bungled it.
cues.zh: 他们搞砸了。

cues.en: They bought only access to Skype. They didn't get the source code. They didn't get control with the network.
cues.zh: 他们只买到了 Skype 的访问权限，没拿到源代码，也没控制住网络。

cues.en: So that's sort of like, it's
cues.zh: 所以这有点像，就是

cues.en: unclear why their lawyers were not briefed.
cues.zh: 不清楚为什么没向他们的律师通报。

cues.en: But we didn't get what we want. So we had to try again, but we can't do that while do... EVA is sitting there.
cues.zh: 但我们没拿到想要的。所以只能再试一次，可只要 EVA 还杵在那儿，我们就干不了。

cues.en: So we get eBay to sell it again at a loss, and now they're not quite as good a friend of NSA.
cues.zh: 于是我们让 eBay 亏本再卖一次，现在他们就不太算 NSA 的好朋友了。

cues.en: We're working on that relationship. So we got Microsoft to buy it instead, and this time they got all of it.
cues.zh: 我们正在修补那层关系。于是我们让 Microsoft 转而买下它，这次他们拿到了全部。

cues.en: And Microsoft has now changed the the architecture of Skype to be centralised. Now Skype goes through Microsoft servers, very convenient,
cues.zh: 而 Microsoft 现在已经把 Skype 的架构改成了集中式。现在 Skype 都走 Microsoft 服务器，非常方便，

cues.en: where it will be decrypted if need be.
cues.zh: 需要时可以在那里解密。

cues.en: That was a pretty expensive operation, but it was necessary. We couldn't have people communicating
cues.zh: 那次行动开销很大，但很有必要。我们不能让人在

cues.en: outside our jurisdiction.
cues.zh: 我们的管辖范围之外通信。

cues.en: So,
cues.zh: 所以，

cues.en: it's a very big hammer.
cues.zh: 这是一把非常大的锤子。

cues.en: It requires
